infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MVMNT uses your location only while you are at a run's meeting point, to check you in. It is never tracked in the background and never shared with other members.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MVMNT uses the camera to scan a friend's code when you are standing together, and — only if you choose to — to take one selfie that helps find you in the club's run photos. The selfie is uploaded and you can delete it at any time; code scanning records nothing.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MVMNT opens your photo library only when you choose a profile picture. Nothing else is read or uploaded.
